Derivatives of the Bessel Ratio

Source: R/special.R
bessel_i_ratio_derivs.Rd

\(A(\kappa)\) and its first four derivatives, obtained by differentiating \(A' = 1 - A/\kappa - A^2\) repeatedly.

Usage

bessel_i_ratio_derivs(kappa)

Arguments

kappa

A positive numeric vector.

Value

A named list with A and its derivatives d1 to d4.

Details

Each order is written in the orders below it, so the whole table costs the two Bessel evaluations of bessel_i_ratio and nothing more. The first identity follows from \(I_0' = I_1\) and \(I_1' = I_0 - I_1/\kappa\); the alternative, a Bessel function of higher order per derivative, costs more and is less accurate at large \(\kappa\), where the functions themselves overflow and only their ratio does not. \(A'\) is the variance of a cosine and therefore positive.

See also

bessel_i_ratio, bessel_i_ratio_inverse

Examples

bessel_i_ratio_derivs(2)$d1
#> [1] 0.1642232
